For j = 2 (even): D(X) = x1 - x2 + x3 - ...; D(X\{x2}) = D(x1, x3, x4, ...) = x1 - x3 + x4 - ...; x2 - D(X\{x2}) = x2 - x1 + x3 - x4 + ...; D(X) - that = x1 - x2 + x3 - x4 + ... - x2 + x1 - x3 + x4 - ... = 2x1 - 2x2 = 2(x1 - x2).
